reviews.content:
I was honestly skeptical at first—I’ve tried other lash serums that didn’t really do much. But Babe Original’s Renewing Lash Serum totally impressed me. Around week 3, I noticed less lash fallout and a bit more fullness, but by week 6? My lashes looked like I had on the most natural set of extensions—and all I did was swipe this on morning and night.

The formula is lightweight, non-greasy, and dries quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. It hasn’t irritated my eyes at all, which is huge because I usually have to be careful with anything near them. It feels super gentle but still delivers real results.

It also wears perfectly under makeup, and I’ve found myself reaching for mascara less because my lashes already look long and defined. Honestly, this is the first lash product I’ve used that actually made a noticeable difference—and didn’t feel like a chore to apply.

If you’re looking for something low-maintenance that actually works, this is it!

reviews.content: I have been using the new Renewing Serum for over a month now and already see a difference in my lashes; I initially noticed less shedding of existing lashes in the first week or so of use. Following that, I began to see new lashes growth and thickening of the lash hairs. My lashes are longer, thicker, and stronger than they were prior to using this serum, and I also noticed that I use less mascara; I used to use 3 heavy handed layers, and Now I just do two layers with a much lighter hand. This new formula is very gentle, and is made without prostaglandin. Some formulas of lash serum cause me to get little temporary bumps along my lash line, but I didn’t experience that with this one. It is a gentle, effective lash growth serum and I am excited to see my continued results over the next couple months!
